messages:
sam: Quick follow-up from last night's DB failover postmortem — thanks everyone for the write-up. I want to pilot a lightweight 'remediation escrow' pattern so we don't lose ownership after the postmortem closes. Idea: assign a primary owner + escrow (backup) owner and an explicit escrow deadline, plus an automated reminder cadence. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

maria: I like that. Can we pair escrow with tiered SLAs? e.g., P0 remedial changes = 72h escrow, P1 = 7 days, P2 = 21 days. Escrow owner is the fallback if primary misses deadline. :thumbsup:

julia: Also we should standardize comms. Proposal: when postmortem action created, notify the oncall channel, the service Slack channel, and the weekly remediation standup agenda. Keep updates terse: "action X — owner — ETA — blocker" once per 3 business days.

kevin: A couple notes: 1) recurring incidents should auto-link to a recurring-incident tag in the tracker so we can spot patterns. 2) we should auto-generate a short recurrence summary in the postmortem e.g., "this is incident #4 in 60 days, same error bucket: PG-connection-timeout". That helps prioritize heavier fixes.

ashok: I'll prototype a tracker card template in the remediation board. Minimal fields I want: Owner, Escrow owner, Escrow deadline, Jira link, Blockers, Verify metric, Recovery plan, Recurrence tag. Will add a "Escrow auto-reminder" field which pings owner + escrow 24h before deadline.

oncall-bot: [deploy] scheduled: remediation-tracker v0.3 -> production by ashok (ETA 2026-03-23). :robot_face:

sam: Example escrow template (draft):
```
Escrow record:
- Owner: @<owner>
- Escrow (backup): @<backup>
- Priority: P0/P1/P2
- Escrow deadline: YYYY-MM-DD
- Verification metric: error_rate < 0.1% over 24h
- Blockers: free-text
- Recurrence tag: e.g., "db-conn-timeout-v4"
- Notes: rollback plan / feature-flag link
```

maria: Love the verification metric field. Can we require a short test plan before closing escrow? Something like: "manual smoke + infra metric check" or a PR that adds a canary check.

julia: For IC rotation: let's add an "IC observer" slot on the tracker so the next IC can review outstanding escrows during handoff. That should reduce forgotten items across shifts.

kevin: Automation idea: if an action has recurrence tag and hits 3 incidents in 60 days, escalate to the "recurrence review" board and assign a process-retrospective (longer ticket) with a 2-week SLA.

ashok: WIP: I'll put a pilot board in the infra workspace and add webhook that creates reminders. Expect PR with schema + README by Fri.

sam: Next steps: (1) ashok creates pilot board + schema (due Fri), (2) maria drafts the escrow SLA tiers + test-plan requirement (due Mon), (3) julia adds IC-observer handoff line to handoff playbook (due Mon), (4) kevin sketches recurrence escalation rule for alerts (due Tue). I'll kick off a 15min demo next Wed to show the pilot. If everyone OK, we'll run pilot for 4 weeks and evaluate. :raised_hands:

maria: OK. assigning in notes. :calendar:

julia: sounds good. I'll join demo.

kevin: noted. I'll prototype the recurrence rule in the alerts repo.

ashok: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/remediation-board/pull/12 — includes fields + reminder cron. Feedback welcome.

sam: Thanks all. Let's try to keep updates in this thread or drop a one-line update in #eng-oncall when a milestone is hit. :eyes:
